Hi everyone! Merhaba!

My name is Öznur. I'm a native Turkish speaker with over 9 years of teaching experiences.  
I have Bachelor's and Master's degree in Education.  I currently live in Italy and I am fully dedicated to teaching English and Turkish online.

My teaching methods are flexible and I can help students in many ways. If you want to learn with me, you can choose one of the courses suits you best:

TURKISH COURSES:

1) Basic Turkish 0-A1 (Beginners)
These are structured lessons. If you are absolute beginner or you cannot sustain a conversation in Turkish, this course is for you. I will provide you materials and you will learn from the scratch! I will speak in Turkish most of the time to make you familiar with the langauge. But no worries, I speak clearly and slowly.

2) Interactive Turkish A2-B2 (Intermediate - Advanced level)
You know some Turkish and you want to improve it! This course is for you! You will be learning more difficult grammar structures, more colloquial and vocabulary.

ENGLISH COURSES:

1) Basic English 0-A1 (Beginners)
This course is meant for the speakers who I speak their langauges. If you're one of Turkish, Italian, Spanish or French speaker who wants to learn English, this course is for you.

2) Interactive English A2-B2 (Intermediate - Advanced level)
The main purpose of this course is to bring you out of your silent stagnation, give you confidence and fluency. These are lessons for people who either want to focus more on other aspects of English such as writing or reading or for the people who have particular vocabulary they want to learn.

INFORMAL TUTORING 
Informal tutoring is where you practise the language having a conversation with me. This is real life conversation with no preparation.

If you have any questions please feel free to send me message and I'll get back to you.

We’ll practice together using these materials, followed by a conversation about the topics we’ve covered. This approach will help you improve all your language skills. See you in the lesson!

pro_course_detail.title: Writing Feedback for Every Level
pro_course_detail.description: This lesson is focused on developing your writing abilities! Before class, you’ll submit a text that we will carefully review together. We’ll go over areas for improvement, discuss grammar, vocabulary, and style, and work through detailed corrections. By the end of the session, you’ll have a clearer understanding of how to structure your thoughts and express them in writing more effectively. This process will help you feel more confident in writing well-crafted texts going forward.

pro_course_detail.description:
Hi there! In these lessons, I’ll provide you with listening and reading materials to boost your English. We’ll practice together using these materials, followed by a conversation about the topics we’ve covered. This approach will help you improve all your language skills. See you in the lesson!

Merhaba! Bu derslerde, İngilizcenizi geliştirmek için dinleme ve okuma materyalleri sunacağım. Bu materyalleri birlikte çalışacağız ve ardından işlediğimiz konular hakkında bir sohbet edeceğiz. Bu yaklaşım, tüm dil becerilerinizi geliştirmenize yardımcı olacak. Derste görüşmek üzere!

pro_course_detail.title: UNPLANNED English Conversation practice - Plansız İngilizce Konuşma Pratiği
pro_course_detail.description:
This is a relaxed, spontaneous hour of conversation with no set agenda. If you're advanced in English and prefer a more flexible approach, or if you're looking to get comfortable with impromptu speaking, this is perfect for you! We can discuss anything from current events and daily routines to music, recent movies, or whatever comes to mind—the best part is challenging yourself to step outside your comfort zone! I'll support you with vocabulary and help you express yourself effectively. Let's chat!

I can provide a PDF after the lessons with tips, vocabulary and mistakes, upon request

Bu, belirli bir programın olmadığı, rahat ve spontane bir sohbet saati. Eğer İngilizce seviyen ileri düzeydeyse ve daha esnek bir yaklaşımı tercih ediyorsan ya da doğaçlama konuşmada kendini rahat hissetmek istiyorsan, bu tam sana göre! Güncel olaylardan ve günlük rutinlerden müziğe, son filmlere ya da aklımıza gelen herhangi bir konuya kadar her şeyi konuşabiliriz—en güzel yanı, kendini rahat alanının dışına çıkmaya zorlaman! Sana kelime bilgisi konusunda destek olacak ve kendini etkili bir şekilde ifade etmene yardımcı olacağım. Hadi sohbet edelim!

Derslerden sonra istersen ipuçları, kelime bilgisi ve hatalarını içeren bir PDF de sağlayabilirim

pro_course_detail.title: PLANNED English Conversation practice - Planlı İngilizce Konuşma Pratiği
pro_course_detail.description:
In this lesson, you'll choose a specific topic for us to discuss—it's a bit more structured than unplanned conversation. To get the most out of this session, it’s ideal if you’re already familiar with some basic English vocabulary, common verbs, and at least one or two tenses. Once you select a topic, I'll prepare questions, provide video materials if you'd like, and teach you related vocabulary. The choice is entirely yours! After the lesson, I'll send you a PDF with corrections and helpful tips to keep in mind. Let's chat!

Please contact me after booking the lesson to inform me about your chosen topic or let me offer you topics so we can decide together. :)

Bu derste, konuşmamız için belirli bir konu seçeceksiniz—plansız bir sohbete göre biraz daha yapılandırılmış bir ders olacak. Bu oturumdan en iyi şekilde yararlanmanız için temel İngilizce kelime bilgisine, yaygın fiillere ve en az bir ya da iki tense'e aşina olmanız faydalı olacaktır. Bir konu seçtiğinizde, sizin için sorular hazırlayacağım, isterseniz video materyalleri sağlayacağım ve konuyla ilgili kelime bilgisini öğreteceğim. Seçim tamamen size ait! Dersin ardından, düzeltmeler ve dikkate almanız gereken faydalı ipuçları içeren bir PDF göndereceğim. Hadi sohbet edelim!

Lütfen dersi ayırttıktan sonra seçtiğiniz konu hakkında bilgi vermek için benimle iletişime geçin ya da size konu önerileri sunmamı isteyin, böylece birlikte karar verebiliriz. :)
